SEO_DESCRIPTION: What breaks, fixed. What is new, done right. Agents, integrations and MCP servers with a measurable method.

HERO.DESCRIPTION: I lead a development team and connect AI agents to real systems: integrations, MCP servers and CI/CD, with security and numbers.

STEPS.LABEL: problem or idea
STEPS.TITLE: Listen before proposing.
STEPS.TEXT: It all starts with something that slows the business down or an idea nobody has tried. First I find out what hurts and who it hurts.

STEPS.LABEL: understand
STEPS.TITLE: Take it apart, piece by piece.
STEPS.TEXT: Code, data, processes and people. I audit before I touch anything, to know what breaks and why.

STEPS.LABEL: build
STEPS.TITLE: Build what is needed.
STEPS.TEXT: Architecture, integrations, MCP servers and agents that work with real systems, with permissions and a human in the loop.

STEPS.LABEL: measure
STEPS.TITLE: A number that proves it.
STEPS.TEXT: I define the metric that will say whether it works. Without a number there is no improvement, only opinions.

STEPS.LABEL: in production
STEPS.TITLE: And keep it running.
STEPS.TEXT: CI/CD, review and security so it reaches production and stays there. Done right.

EXPERIENCE_DATA.TITLE: ERP Manager - Garsaco Import S.L.
DESCRIPTIONS: - I lead the development team: priorities, code review and training.
- I design the architecture and integrations between the Odoo ERP, the online shops and internal processes.
- I build and maintain custom Odoo modules for the company's day-to-day work.
- I set up CI/CD pipelines to test and deploy automatically and safely.
- I build MCP servers to connect AI agents with the company's systems.
- I build dashboards on business data to support decision-making.
- I run code and security audits before changes reach production.
